decisions.reason: As a specialist naval lighting line that fits the firm's robust marine offering and likely has long qualification and sales cycles, its option value remains meaningful and does not yet justify withdrawal.

This general interior luminaire is in the firm's core market but appears less strategically prominent by 2024, so it is worth keeping for now while demand resolves, though it faces a relatively high pruning risk in a broad portfolio.
Because the firm presents this pendant luminaire as a flagship release closely aligned with its direction in modern lighting solutions, management would be unlikely to drop it within the next year.

The marine searchlight remains on the website after launch and fits the firm's specialist, application-specific portfolio, so management would likely retain it as a viable niche option unless results deteriorate clearly.
